contract.goal: Carry out the change described by the issue in the repository the run input's subject pins

problem.exists: cellfill.Registry.Alpha maps a fill id to AlphaFill{Construct, NeedsSubject}, and cellspec.Build refuses before construction when a declared alpha needs contract.subject and the run input supplied none. Registry.Beta maps a fill id to a bare BetaFactory with no such declaration.
problem.expected: A beta fill can declare the same requirement, and cellspec.Build enforces it the same way — before the beta constructor runs.
problem.diverges: cds.assess cannot act without contract.subject (it reconstructs the candidate from it), but declares nothing. A cell pairing cds.assess with an alpha that does not need a subject would construct beta and fail later, inside Review, as an episode malfunction rather than a spec refusal.

changing any CUE schema or fixture
changing cellkernel, cdsassess, cdspatch or cellwork

design.approach: Mirror the alpha side exactly. AlphaFill/LookupAlpha/ConstructAlpha and the Build check already exist and were reviewed; the beta side becomes their reflection so there is one pattern rather than two shapes for one idea. Registry.Beta's value type changes, so every construction site and test updates mechanically; no compatibility shim.
invariants: the alpha side keeps its current behaviour and error text
a fill id resolves to its registration in exactly one place per side
the generic runner still names no domain package

impact.why: the new type, the new lookup, and the Beta field's type live here
the generic beta registrations are built with the old value type
the requirement is checked before the beta constructor runs
cds.assess is registered here and is the fill that needs the subject
the new refusal needs a witness beside the alpha one
